spec_match.rationale: Detects support with the exact surface (new RegExp('\\A','u')) and cross-checks it with the semantic probe; rewrites the escapes to the spec's modifier synonyms or to lookaround emulation.

interactive.rationale: The detection button, four strategy radios, a pattern input and the corpus button all execute real RegExps.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The card's detection, the forceable strategies and the 10×12 corpus are present.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers engines without modifiers (lookaround path), the cheap-detection-vs-semantics mismatch warning, and the regex-literal early error in the code notes.

references.rationale: See-also links chromestatus.com/feature/5187917373898752, the TC39 spec and explainer sections the page relies on.

conformance.rationale: Same contract as synonym-equivalence-with-modifiers and unicode-mode-compiles.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12 via Playwright (chrome-devtools-mcp is not available in this environment, so this is NOT DevTools-MCP verification), run in two modes: default and --js-flags=--js-regexp-buffer-boundaries. Every control was exercised at 1280x800 and at 360x740 (DPR 3, touch). Document overflow was 0px in both classes and modes, every control was at least 44px tall, and full-page screenshots were read. Default: hasBufferBoundaries=false, auto path=modifiers (labelled), native throws for 10/10 patterns, and the two fallbacks agree on 120/120 cells. Flagged: native vs modifiers agree 120/120 and modifiers vs lookaround agree 120/120. A 81px mobile overflow from a long h2 was found and fixed (now 0px).

design_system.rationale: Uses only the public/styles.css variables via the shared bb.css. Buttons set both background and color; status colours are emerald-dark/rose on stone.

accessibility.rationale: Native buttons, radios, checkboxes and selects with visible labels in fieldset/legend; aria-pressed on preset buttons; polite live verdicts; 3px focus outlines; tables use caption and scope inside a focusable region. The accessibility tree was not inspected with DevTools MCP, which is unavailable here.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Both classes driven in both engine modes: 0px document overflow, 44px targets, single-column stages; wide tables scroll inside a labelled focusable region.

openQuestions.title: Re-verify on a Chrome 159 build where the feature is on by default or staged
openQuestions.detail: Verified only on Chrome 153 with --js-flags=--js-regexp-buffer-boundaries. Confirm that chrome://flags/#enable-javascript-harmony enables it once V8 marks it staged (V8 main has it in FOREACH_STAGED_FEATURE_FLAG), then update the banner when it ships by default.

openQuestions.title: Lookaround emulation of \Z vs modifiers in v-mode with case-insensitivity
openQuestions.detail: The corpus covers i and v, but not the s, y or d flags. Extend it, and add patterns where \A sits inside a lookbehind.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible text input textarea labels validation feedback
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Visible <label for> on every control, hints via aria-describedby, no placeholder-only labels.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Every input/textarea/select has a visible label; hints use aria-describedby; flags/radios are grouped in fieldset+legend.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible data table responsive small screens
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Semantic table with caption and scope headers inside a role=region, tabindex=0, aria-labelledby wrapper that scrolls; sticky row headers.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: All result tables use caption, th scope, region wrapper with tabindex and a sticky row-header column; the page itself has 0px overflow at 360px (the table scrolls inside its region).

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible live region announce async result status
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use aria-live polite for standard result updates; reserve assertive for critical; debounce noisy regions.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Engine and result verdicts are polite live regions; typing-driven updates are debounced 120-150ms; tables are not live (the verdict summarises them).

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel form without horizontal overflow mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Wrap control rows with flex-wrap, min-width:0 on grid/flex children, intrinsic sizing.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Controls use flex-wrap fieldsets; .stage children have min-width:0; long code/output uses overflow-wrap; measured 0px overflow at 360px after fixing a long unbreakable h2 on detect-and-desugar.

summary: A ready-to-copy migration path with live evidence that native, modifier and lookaround spellings are interchangeable on a 120-cell corpus.
